NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Training reads steps, workouts (including from your watch), heart rate and active energy from Apple Health to show them in your plan and next to your sessions. The data stays on your iPhone — the app doesn't send it anywhere or store it in backups.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Training saves finished workouts — strength and cardio — to Apple Health. When your watch records the same workout, the app removes its own copy.
NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Training connects to your sports watch over Bluetooth to show the current exercise on it and receive set confirmations. The data stays between your phone and your watch.
